title: Union Budget
definition: The Annual Financial Statement mandated under Article 112 of the Indian Constitution, detailing the estimated receipts and expenditures of the Government of India for a financial year.
importanceInUpsc: Central microtopic for Economy (GS-3 Public Finance, Fiscal Policy, Taxation) and Polity (Parliamentary Procedure, Constitutional Provisions). Heavily tested via conceptual mechanics of deficits, budget enactment stages, and structural reforms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Union Budget under Article 112.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Constitutional framework of Parliament and executive
